item.tib: b+hu ru drag po dmar nag me phreng rgyud las sde brgyad srog dbang tsi ta gter 'phreng
item.coloph: de ltar 'gu ru drag po sde brgyad srog dbang rgyas par bskur pa tsi ta gsang ba'i gter 'phreng zhes bya ba/ mchog sprul mi shig rdo rje nyid kyi bka'i dngos slob chen po gter gyi bum bzang gi mnga' bdag dal dpal g.yung drung bstan 'dzin bde chen mi 'gyur snying po zhes pa'i (pas) bI gar chen po la sogs srid pa'i dregs tshogs bran bzhin bkol ba nyid kyi dgongs pa'i sa bcad de/ 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i gsung la brten te/ thos thung dz+nya na hri d+ha'i (d+has) shing 'brug gi zla tshes legs par mi yi dbang po'i pho brang sbyin rdzogs kyi yar rtser ngo mtshar rab gsal du sug bris bgyis te/ bkra shis dge legs phyogs bcur dar rgyas shog/
